correctness.rationale: For the full parameter range \(0<c\le1/2\), \(\theta>0\), \(\theta c<1\) and the stated initial region, exact updates prove positive invariance and nonincreasing predator abundance (strict after the first update). A contradiction using the predator multiplier establishes \(v_n\to0\); a logistic lower comparison forces \(u_n\to1\). Writing \(w_n=1-u_n\), direct one-step estimates yield \(w_n=a v_n+c a^3v_n^2+O(v_n^3)\), \(a=(1+c)^{-1}\), hence \(v_{n+1}=v_n-Kv_n^3-Lv_n^4+O(v_n^5)\) with \(K=\theta c/(1+c)^3\), \(L=3\theta c^2/(1+c)^5\). Summing the exact \(v_n^{-2}\) increment twice gives \(v_n=A n^{-1/2}-L/(2K^2)n^{-1}+O(\log n/n^{3/2})\) and \(u_n=1-A n^{-1/2}/(1+c)+n^{-1}/\theta+O(\log n/n^{3/2})\). Rational coefficient identities were checked with check.py for three parameter pairs; finite orbit diagnostics are supplementary and do not prove the limiting claims.

value.rationale: The codimension-two neutral boundary is motivated by predator invasion with vanishing first derivative of invasion fitness, so linearization cannot predict the relaxation speed. The theorem holds for every positive initial state in a natural invariant region, with sharp two-term extinction and prey-recovery coefficients. The unexpected saturation-independent \(1/\theta\) second prey coefficient reveals an exact cancellation between the fast prey adjustment and cubic/quartic predator drift, going beyond qualitative limit convergence.
